chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Abi Nasr, from Thaʿlabah, from Zurarah, who said:
I heard Abu Jaʿfar (عليه السلام) saying: “Were it not that we are increased, we would be exhausted.”
He said: I said, “Are you increased with something that the Messenger of Allah (صلى الله عليه وآله) did not know?”
He said: “Indeed, when that occurs, it is presented to the Messenger of Allah (صلى الله عليه وآله), then to the Imams, then the matter comes to us.”

key_terms.الْأَئِمَّةِ: the Imams, the divinely appointed successors in the hadith’s context
key_terms.الْأَمْرُ: the matter, referring here to the knowledge or affair being conveyed
key_terms.عُرِضَ: it was presented, indicating transmission by presentation before reaching them
key_terms.لَأَنْفَدْنَا: we would be exhausted or depleted, meaning what is with them would run out without increase
key_terms.نَزْدَادُ: we receive increase, referring here to ongoing augmentation in knowledge

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith explain the continued increase of knowledge of the Imams?
ai.summary: This hadith describes that the Imams receive ongoing increase in knowledge and that this does not occur independently of the Messenger of Allah (صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم). Rather, such knowledge is presented first to the Messenger of Allah, then to the Imams, and then reaches the present Imam. The report emphasizes continuity of divinely granted knowledge within the line of the Ahl al-Bayt.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Abu Nasr, from Sa’alba, from Zurara who said,
‘I heard Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘Had we<sup>asws</sup> not been increased, we<sup>asws</sup> would run out’.
I said, ‘Are you<sup>asws</sup> being increased with something which Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> did not know of?’
He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘But, if it was that, it would be presented to Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> (first), then to the Imams<sup>asws</sup>, then the matter would end up to us<sup>asws</sup>’.
en.sarwar: 3. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from abu Nasr from Tha‘labah from Zurarah who has said that he heard abu Ja‘far (a.s.) say the following.
“Would we not receive additional (knowledge) we would diminish (in knowledge).”
The narrator has said that he asked the Imams (a.s.) “Do receive additional something that the Messenger of Allah does not know?”
The Imam (a.s.) said, “The fact of the matter is that when that happens, it is presented to the Messenger of Allah then to the Imams and then it reaches us.”
